title: Price address negations in uniform signed SWAP words
head: ea5a00d0e3a706eef4a07788f8fe68e1c92c7334
body:
In the uniform integer-address SWAP model, mod2 crossing cuts miss address signs. This package adds a separate determinant-sheet charge and proves the exact tariff for any mixture of signed anti-diagonal targets, with arbitrary free scalar mixing and restored dirty spectators:

`r*(2*min(A,B)+max(A,B)) + t*C`, where t targets have determinant -1, A/B price the two signed shear orientations, and C prices either address-coordinate NEG.

The mod2 ADD inequalities are inherited from [PR2544](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2544) at `9fb1552f12ca4777ca660461a8b602e709285f99`, which credits Aaron Wang's PR2444 handoff and Ross Richardson's PR1989/PR2415 crossing bound. The new obligation is `n_NEG>=t`; a two-sheet rank cut counts each target even when their overall determinant parity cancels. Exact integer three-shear words, with one NEG for each determinant-negative target, attain all charges together.

The proof is for complete formal `F2[GL2(Z)]` identities, equivalently fixed words on full integer streams or an unbounded family of moduli. It explicitly does not establish the lower bound for separately optimized words at one finite modulus: at M=2 three shears already swap coordinates. No native compiler, recursive supplier, physical tape cost or selected exponent is claimed.

Validation: native Python 3.12.7 registered replay and native 3.14.5 direct optimized replay pass. The verifier checks 930 rank-one factors, 1,364 full formal attaining endpoints, 42,625 rational tariffs and 720 mixed prefixes. Mathematical controls include a formal perturbation invisible to all quotient cuts, omitted signs, finite-modulus failure, negative-price loops and changed higher-rank units. Six export/evidence tests reject source and typed-receipt drift and verify read-only Git-free replay. A separate AI reviewer checks the proof and independent matrix calculations; the review receipt binds the submitted files.

Reproduce: `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/integer-address-signed-swap`. Current canonical main and source2544 remain unchanged at submission; recent open PR bodies/source comments were checked. The complete cached Discussion snapshot is older, as disclosed in TASK.json; overlap search is not proof of novelty. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2544#issuecomment-6195288484).

Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate AI review. Predecessor attribution is retained. Hosted CI, human review and proof-assistant formalization are not asserted.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
